scope.message: WIP: notes panel before branch switch

invalid.name: neg_stage_absolute_path
invalid.expected_error: paths must be repo-relative; absolute paths are rejected

invalid.name: neg_stage_traversal_path
invalid.expected_error: dot-dot traversal escapes the repository and is rejected

invalid.name: neg_stage_hunk_payload_rejected
invalid.expected_error: whole-file stage carries no hunk field; hunk payloads belong to cmd.git.stage_hunks

invalid.name: neg_stage_missing_untracked_flag
invalid.expected_error: stage requires an explicit include_untracked decision

invalid.name: neg_unstage_forbids_untracked_flag
invalid.expected_error: unstage never admits an untracked flag; untracked files are outside the index

invalid.name: neg_unstage_wrong_backend
invalid.expected_error: this family is Git-only; a jujutsu scope cannot satisfy it

invalid.name: neg_remote_fetch_url_with_userinfo
invalid.expected_error: remote URLs carry no userinfo; credentials come only from brokered leases

invalid.name: neg_remote_push_url_with_credentials
invalid.expected_error: credential-bearing push URLs are rejected before any config write

invalid.name: neg_remote_missing_push_urls
invalid.expected_error: remote.update requires a distinct validated push URL array, not a bare fetch URL

invalid.name: neg_stash_create_message_too_long
invalid.expected_error: stash messages are bounded at 500 characters

invalid.name: neg_stash_apply_missing_preview
invalid.expected_error: stash.apply requires an approved current preview reference

invalid.name: neg_branch_create_invalid_ref
invalid.expected_error: branch names follow git check-ref-format rules; spaces and dot-dot are rejected

invalid.name: neg_branch_delete_missing_confirmation
invalid.expected_error: branch.delete requires explicit dangerous confirmation

invalid.name: neg_branch_delete_confirmation_false
invalid.expected_error: a false dangerous confirmation cannot authorize a destructive delete

invalid.name: neg_git_stash_spelling_not_primary
invalid.expected_error: cmd.git.stash.* spellings are not primaries; the canonical stash commands live under cmd.source_control

invalid.name: neg_git_branch_spelling_not_primary
invalid.expected_error: cmd.git.branch.* spellings are not primaries; the canonical branch commands live under cmd.source_control

invalid.name: neg_accepted_result_carries_receipt
invalid.expected_error: accepted is not terminal success; only terminal outcomes carry a receipt

invalid.name: neg_succeeded_result_claims_unknown_effect
invalid.expected_error: a succeeded result cannot carry an unknown effect

invalid.name: neg_unknown_error_allows_retry
invalid.expected_error: effect_unknown keeps retry_allowed=false with reconciliation-only next actions

invalid.name: neg_identity_substitution_missing_repo
invalid.expected_error: paths cannot substitute for repo_id identity; the scope stays incomplete without it

invalid.name: neg_stage_untracked_without_admission
invalid.expected_error: declared untracked paths require include_untracked=true or exact refusal

invalid.name: neg_stage_declared_untracked_outside_paths
invalid.expected_error: declared untracked paths must be a subset of the staged paths

invalid.name: neg_remote_update_stale_config_generation
invalid.expected_error: expected_config_generation must equal the fenced config generation of the expected git state

invalid.name: neg_permission_class_command_mismatch
invalid.expected_error: the permission class must name the exact scoped command

invalid.name: neg_receipt_index_generation_regresses
invalid.expected_error: receipt generations are monotonic; an after-generation below before is untruthful

invalid.name: neg_stage_path_with_control_byte
invalid.expected_error: control bytes are never safe in a repo-relative path, even where spaces are allowed

invalid.name: neg_stage_path_with_trailing_space
invalid.expected_error: leading and trailing spaces are rejected; only interior spaces are safe
